CommunityApplications.Profile:
**MuseForge** - a self-hosted AI studio for video, images, audio, long-form text and audiobooks.
Everything is generated on your own hardware; nothing is sent to a cloud service. Besides direct generation there is a Director mode that plans a whole music video or short film from one sentence, a Storywriter for novel-length prose with translation and a continuity audit, and an audiobook producer that turns a document into spoken chapters with a voice per character. The web interface is also a REST API, and a built-in MCP endpoint lets AI agents drive it.
Hardware, before you install: an NVIDIA GPU with at least 6 GB of VRAM and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit on the host. There is no AMD, Apple Silicon or CPU-only mode. Model weights are 50-300 GB depending on which models you use, so give the appdata share room.
Support: https://github.com/fgilde/MuseForge/issues
